jobs.title: IT Domain Architect Trading
jobs.description:
Mission

Energy markets are being reshaped in real time – and the technology behind trading sits right at the heart of it. As IT Domain Architect for Energy Trading, you will own the architectural vision for the systems that power Alpiq’s Trading Division, and turn today’s landscape into the target landscape of tomorrow.

You will define that target together with business and IT stakeholders, then steer our applications, integrations and data towards it – making sure every solution is fit for purpose, secure by design, scalable and genuinely aligned with how our trading and risk teams work. Spanning front, middle and back office across the full trade lifecycle, this is a role with real ownership, high visibility and the mandate to shape where we go next.

Your main responsibilities

•
• Define, own and continuously evolve the IT target landscape for the Trading Division – and drive the transformation that gets us there, hand in hand with business and IT.

• Keep a clear, living view of our trading landscape – trading, position and risk management, market data, pricing, settlement and regulatory reporting – and turn the gap to target into a pragmatic, prioritised roadmap.

• Shape solution designs across the trade lifecycle (front, middle and back office), balancing business needs, IT strategy, security, integration principles and operational reality.

• Be the go-to architecture partner for projects, product teams, vendors and system integrators, setting clear standards and guardrails for our ETRM, risk, market-data and settlement platforms.

• Safeguard quality where it matters most – reviewing architectural impact, risks, dependencies and technical design debt before major changes go live, with a sharp eye on data integrity, latency, resilience and auditability.

• Help steer architecture governance, design authority reviews, roadmap planning, portfolio priorities and make-or-buy decisions for the division.

Make sure trading regulation (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II) is designed into the landscape from the start, rather than bolted on later.

• Champion standardisation, simplification, application reduction and modernisation – always weighing business value, security, sustainability, quality and cost.

Your impact

• This is where our value “Create value” comes to life. The decisions you make ensure the Trading Division’s technology investments deliver real, lasting business outcomes and support Alpiq’s long-term strategic direction.

Because you define the target landscape with the business and steer us towards it, you strike the right balance between innovation and risk, ambition and operational excellence. You will be a trusted sparring partner to trading, risk and IT – the person who translates bold ambitions and regulatory demands into architecture and technology decisions that make future growth and transformation possible.

Your profile

• We’re looking for an architect who is as comfortable with trading and risk as with technology. You likely bring:

• A degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Financial Engineering or a related field – or equivalent hands-on experience.

• A track record in enterprise, domain or solution architecture, ideally within energy trading, commodities or financial markets.

• A solid grasp of the trade lifecycle and ETRM/CTRM systems (trading, position and risk management, market data, pricing, settlement and regulatory reporting) and platforms such as Murex, Endur or Orchestrade.

• Strong solution and integration architecture skills, plus data architecture and security know-how in real-time, data-intensive environments.

• The ability to turn business strategy, trading needs and regulation into a clear IT target landscape, solution designs and technology guardrails.

• Experience with architecture governance, design reviews, lifecycle and technical-debt management, and confident technology decision-making.

• Experience with Enterprise I ntegration P atterns (EIP) , Event Driven Architectures and with data centrics plat forms such as Foundry or Databri c ks

• Ease working across internal delivery teams and external service providers, system integrators and platform vendors.

• Excellent stakeholder-management, facilitation, communication and influencing skills, with a structured, analytical and business-minded approach.

Who You’ll Work With

You will sit at the crossroads of business and technology, working closely with:

• Trading, Portfolio Management and Risk teams across front, middle and back office

• Enterprise Architecture and the Design Authority

• Business Relationship Managers, Product Owners and Demand Managers

• Project Managers, Delivery Leads, Solution Architects and technical experts

• Security, Data, Integration, Infrastructure, Operations and Service Management

• ETRM platform vendors, system integrators and external partners

• Portfolio, Governance, Risk, Compliance and Finance stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

• A clear, shared IT target landscape for the Trading Division exists – and the estate is visibly moving towards it.

• Solutions are aligned with business outcomes, enterprise architecture standards, security and regulatory requirements.

• Architecture decisions are transparent, well-documented , their context and lineage is tracked in Architecture Desciion Records and applied consistently across projects, products and suppliers.

• Risks, dependencies, exceptions, lifecycle impacts and technical debt are spotted and managed early.

• Roadmaps drive modernisation, simplification, application reduction and cost optimisation.

• Trading, risk and delivery teams receive clear, timely and practical guidance that accelerates quality delivery and business value.

Ready to help shape the future of energy trading at Alpiq? We’d love to meet you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

I mercati dell'energia sono rimodellati in tempo reale e la tecnologia dietro il trading si trova proprio al centro di esso. Come IT Domain Architect for Energy Trading, possederai la visione architettonica per i sistemi che alimentano la Divisione Trading di Alpiq, e trasformerai il paesaggio di oggi nel paesaggio di destinazione di domani.

Potrai definire tale obiettivo insieme a stakeholder aziendali e IT, quindi guidare le nostre applicazioni, integrazioni e dati verso di esso – assicurando che ogni soluzione sia adatta a scopo, sicuro dal design, scalabile e genuinamente allineato a come i nostri team di trading e di rischio lavorano. Spanning front, middle e back office attraverso il ciclo di vita del commercio completo, questo è un ruolo con la proprietà reale, alta visibilità e il mandato di forma dove andiamo dopo.

Le tue principali responsabilità

•
• Definire, possedere e evolvere continuamente il panorama target IT per la Divisione Trading – e guidare la trasformazione che ci porta, mano in mano con business e IT.

• Tenere una visione chiara e viva del nostro paesaggio di trading – trading, gestione della posizione e dei rischi, dati di mercato, prezzi, regolamento e reporting normativo – e trasformare il divario di obiettivo in una roadmap pragmatica e prioritaria.

• Modelli di soluzioni di forma attraverso il ciclo di vita commerciale (ufficio centrale e posteriore), bilanciamento delle esigenze aziendali, strategia IT, sicurezza, principi di integrazione e realtà operativa.

• Siate il partner di architettura per progetti, team di prodotti, venditori e integratori di sistema, stabilendo standard chiari e guardrails per le nostre piattaforme ETRM, rischio, dati di mercato e insediamento.

• Qualità di sicurezza in cui conta di più – rivedere l'impatto architettonico, i rischi, le dipendenze e il debito tecnico di progettazione prima di cambiamenti importanti andare in diretta, con un occhio acuto sull'integrità dei dati, la latenza, resilienza e verificabilità.

• Aiuto steer architettura governance, recensioni autorità di progettazione, pianificazione roadmap, priorità portafoglio e decisioni make-or-buy per la divisione.

Assicurarsi che la regolazione di trading (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II) è progettata nel paesaggio fin dall'inizio, piuttosto che bloccata in seguito.

• Standardizzazione campione, semplificazione, riduzione delle applicazioni e modernizzazione – pesa sempre valore aziendale, sicurezza, sostenibilità, qualità e costi.

Il tuo impatto

• Questo è dove il nostro valore “Crea valore” viene alla vita. Le decisioni che si prendono per garantire gli investimenti tecnologici della Divisione Trading offrono risultati aziendali reali e duraturi e supportano la direzione strategica a lungo termine di Alpiq.

Poiché si definisce il paesaggio target con il business e ci guida verso di esso, si colpisce il giusto equilibrio tra innovazione e rischio, ambizione e eccellenza operativa. Sarete un partner risparmiatore di fiducia per il trading, il rischio e l'IT – la persona che traduce ambizioni audaci e richieste normative in decisioni di architettura e tecnologia che rendono possibile la crescita e la trasformazione futura.

Il tuo profilo

• Stiamo cercando un architetto che sia a suo agio con il trading e il rischio come con la tecnologia. Probabilmente porti:

• Una laurea in Informatica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Ingegneria finanziaria o un campo correlato – o equivalente esperienza hands-on.

• Un track record in architettura aziendale, di dominio o di soluzione, idealmente all'interno di trading energetico, materie prime o mercati finanziari.

• Una solida conoscenza del ciclo di vita commerciale e dei sistemi ETRM/CTRM (trading, position and risk management, dati di mercato, prezzi, regolamento e reporting normativo) e piattaforme come Murex, Endur o Orchestrade.

• Forte capacità di soluzione e integrazione dell'architettura, oltre all'architettura dei dati e al know-how di sicurezza in ambienti in tempo reale e intensivi.

• La capacità di trasformare la strategia di business, le esigenze di trading e la regolazione in un paesaggio obiettivo IT chiaro, progetti di soluzioni e guardrails tecnologia.

• Esperienza con la governance dell'architettura, le recensioni di design, il ciclo di vita e la gestione tecnico-debito, e il processo decisionale di tecnologia sicuro.

• Esperienza con Enterprise I ntegration P atterns (EIP) , Event Driven Architectures and with data centrics plat forms such as Foundry or Databri c ks

• Facilità di lavoro tra i team di consegna interni e i fornitori di servizi esterni, integratori di sistema e fornitori di piattaforme.

• Eccellente gestione delle parti interessate, facilitazione, comunicazione e influenza le competenze, con un approccio strutturato, analitico e orientato al business.

Con chi lavorerai

Ti siederai all'incrocio tra business e tecnologia, lavorando a stretto contatto con:

• Trading, Portfolio Management e Risk team di fronte, centro e back office

• Architettura aziendale e Autorità di progettazione

• Business Relationship Managers, Proprietari di Prodotto e Manager di Richieste

• Project Manager, Delivery Leads, Solution Architects ed esperti tecnici

• Sicurezza, dati, integrazione, infrastrutture, operazioni e gestione dei servizi

• Rivenditori piattaforma ETRM, integratori di sistema e partner esterni

• Portafoglio, Governance, Rischio, Compliance e Finanza

Che successo sembra

• Esiste un paesaggio obiettivo IT chiaro e condiviso per la Divisione Trading – e la tenuta si sta muovendo visibilmente verso di essa.

• Le soluzioni sono allineate con risultati aziendali, standard di architettura aziendale, requisiti di sicurezza e regolamentazione.

• Le decisioni di architettura sono trasparenti, ben documentate , il loro contesto e il loro lignaggio è tracciato in Architettura Desciion Records e applicato coerentemente su progetti, prodotti e fornitori.

• I rischi, le dipendenze, le eccezioni, gli impatti del ciclo di vita e il debito tecnico sono individuati e gestiti in anticipo.

• Roadmaps guida l'ammodernamento, la semplificazione, la riduzione delle applicazioni e l'ottimizzazione dei costi.

• I team di trading, rischio e consegna ricevono una guida chiara, tempestiva e pratica che accelera la consegna di qualità e il valore aziendale.

Pronto ad aiutare a plasmare il futuro del trading energetico ad Alpiq? Ci piacerebbe conoscerti.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mission

Die Energiemärkte werden in Echtzeit neu gestaltet - und die Technologie hinter dem Handel steht im Mittelpunkt. Als IT Domain Architect for Energy Trading besitzen Sie die architektonische Vision für die Systeme, die die Trading Division von Alpiq antreiben, und verwandeln die Landschaft von heute in die Ziellandschaft von morgen.

Sie werden dieses Ziel zusammen mit Geschäfts- und IT-Stakeholdern definieren und dann unsere Anwendungen, Integrationen und Daten darauf zu lenken - um sicherzustellen, dass jede Lösung für den Zweck geeignet, sicher durch Design, skalierbar und wirklich darauf ausgerichtet ist, wie unsere Handels- und Risikoteams arbeiten. Das Front-, Middle- und Back-Office über den gesamten Handelslebenszyklus hinweg ist eine Rolle mit echtem Eigentum, hoher Sichtbarkeit und dem Mandat, zu gestalten, wohin wir als nächstes gehen.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben

•
• Definieren, besitzen und entwickeln Sie die IT-Ziellandschaft für die Trading Division kontinuierlich weiter – und treiben Sie die Transformation voran, die uns dorthin bringt, Hand in Hand mit Business und IT.

• Behalten Sie einen klaren, lebendigen Blick auf unsere Handelslandschaft - Handel, Positions- und Risikomanagement, Marktdaten, Preisgestaltung, Abrechnung und regulatorische Berichterstattung - und verwandeln Sie die Lücke zum Ziel in eine pragmatische, priorisierte Roadmap.

• Gestalten Sie Lösungsdesigns über den gesamten Handelslebenszyklus (Front, Middle und Backoffice), balancieren Sie Geschäftsanforderungen, IT-Strategie, Sicherheit, Integrationsprinzipien und operative Realität.

• Seien Sie der ideale Architekturpartner für Projekte, Produktteams, Anbieter und Systemintegratoren und setzen Sie klare Standards und Leitplanken für unsere ETRM-, Risiko-, Marktdaten- und Abwicklungsplattformen.

• Sichern Sie die Qualität dort, wo sie am wichtigsten ist - Überprüfung von architektonischen Auswirkungen, Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und technischen Designschulden, bevor wichtige Änderungen in Betrieb genommen werden, mit einem scharfen Auge auf Datenintegrität, Latenz, Resilienz und Prüfbarkeit.

• Helfen Sie dabei, Architektur-Governance, Design-Behörden-Überprüfungen, Roadmap-Planung, Portfolioprioritäten und Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen für die Division zu steuern.

Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Handelsregulierung (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II) von Anfang an in die Landschaft entworfen wird, anstatt später angeschraubt zu werden.

• Champion Standardisierung, Vereinfachung, Anwendungsreduzierung und Modernisierung – immer unter Berücksichtigung von Unternehmenswert, Sicherheit, Nachhaltigkeit, Qualität und Kosten.

Ihre Wirkung

• Hier wird unser Wert „Create value zum Leben erweckt. Die von Ihnen getroffenen Entscheidungen stellen sicher, dass die Technologieinvestitionen der Trading Division echte, dauerhafte Geschäftsergebnisse liefern und die langfristige strategische Ausrichtung von Alpiq unterstützen.

Weil Sie mit dem Unternehmen die Ziellandschaft definieren und uns darauf zusteuern, finden Sie die richtige Balance zwischen Innovation und Risiko, Ehrgeiz und operativer Exzellenz. Sie sind ein zuverlässiger Sparringspartner für Handel, Risiko und IT - die Person, die mutige Ambitionen und regulatorische Anforderungen in Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen umsetzt, die zukünftiges Wachstum und Transformation ermöglichen.

Dein Profil

• Wir suchen einen Architekten, der sich mit Handel und Risiko ebenso wohl fühlt wie mit Technologie. Sie bringen wahrscheinlich:

• Ein Abschluss in Informationstechnologie, Informatik, Ingenieurwesen, Finanzingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich - oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• Eine Erfolgsbilanz in der Unternehmens-, Domänen- oder Lösungsarchitektur, idealerweise im Energiehandel, in Rohstoffen oder auf den Finanzmärkten.

• Ein solides Verständnis des Handelslebenszyklus und der ETRM / CTRM-Systeme (Handel, Positions- und Risikomanagement, Marktdaten, Preisgestaltung, Abrechnung und regulatorische Berichterstattung) und Plattformen wie Murex, Endur oder Orchestrade.

• Starke Lösungs- und Integrationsarchitekturkenntnisse sowie Datenarchitektur und Sicherheits-Know-how in datenintensiven Umgebungen in Echtzeit.

• Die Fähigkeit, Geschäftsstrategie, Handelsanforderungen und Regulierung in eine klare IT-Ziellandschaft, Lösungsdesigns und Technologieleitplanken zu verwandeln.

• Erfahrung mit Architektur-Governance, Design-Reviews, Lifecycle und technischem Schuldenmanagement sowie selbstbewusster Technologieentscheidung.

• Erfahrung mit Enterprise I ntegration P atterns (EIP), Event Driven Architectures und mit Data Centrics plat Formen wie Foundry oder Databri c ks

• Einfaches Arbeiten mit internen Lieferteams und externen Dienstleistern, Systemintegratoren und Plattformanbietern.

• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation, Kommunikation und Einflussnahme mit einem strukturierten, analytischen und geschäftsorientierten Ansatz.

Mit wem du arbeiten wirst

Sie werden an der Kreuzung von Business und Technologie sitzen und eng mit:

• Trading-, Portfoliomanagement- und Risikoteams im Front-, Middle- und Back-Office

• Enterprise Architecture und die Design Authority

• Business Relationship Manager, Product Owner und Demand Manager

• Projektmanager, Delivery Leads, Solution Architects und technische Experten

• Sicherheit, Daten, Integration, Infrastruktur, Betrieb und Service Management

• Anbieter von ETRM-Plattformen, Systemintegratoren und externe Partner

• Stakeholder in Portfolio, Governance, Risiko, Compliance und Finanzen

Wie Erfolg aussieht

• Eine klare, gemeinsame IT-Ziellandschaft für die Trading Division existiert – und der Nachlass bewegt sich sichtbar darauf zu.

• Die Lösungen richten sich nach Geschäftsergebnissen, Standards für die Unternehmensarchitektur, Sicherheits- und Regulierungsanforderungen.

• Architekturentscheidungen sind transparent, gut dokumentiert, ihr Kontext und ihre Abstammung werden in Architecture Desciion Records nachverfolgt und konsistent über Projekte, Produkte und Lieferanten hinweg angewendet.

• Risiken, Abhängigkeiten, Ausnahmen, Lebenszyklusauswirkungen und technische Schulden werden frühzeitig erkannt und gemanagt.

• Roadmaps treiben Modernisierung, Vereinfachung, Anwendungsreduzierung und Kostenoptimierung voran.

• Handels-, Risiko- und Lieferteams erhalten eine klare, zeitnahe und praktische Anleitung, die die Qualität der Lieferung und den Geschäftswert beschleunigt.

Mission

Les marchés de l'énergie sont en train d'être remodelés en temps réel – et la technologie derrière le trading est au cœur de celle-ci. En tant qu'architecte de domaine IT pour le trading de l'énergie, vous posséderez la vision architecturale des systèmes qui alimentent Alpiqs Trading Division, et transformerez aujourd'hui le paysage en paysage cible de demain.

Vous définirez cette cible en collaboration avec les partenaires commerciaux et informatiques, puis orienterez nos applications, intégrations et données vers elle – en veillant à ce que chaque solution soit adaptée à l'objectif, sécurisée par la conception, évolutive et réellement alignée sur la façon dont nos équipes de trading et de risque fonctionnent. Devant, au milieu et au fond du cycle de vie du commerce, il s'agit d'un rôle avec une véritable propriété, une grande visibilité et le mandat de façonner où nous allons ensuite.

Vos principales responsabilités

•
• Définir, posséder et développer en permanence le paysage cible de l'informatique pour la division Trading – et conduire la transformation qui nous y conduit, main dans la main avec les affaires et l'informatique.

• Gardez une vision claire et vivante de notre paysage commercial – négociation, position et gestion des risques, données de marché, prix, règlement et rapports réglementaires – et transformez l'écart en une feuille de route pragmatique et prioritaire.

• Conception de solutions de forme tout au long du cycle de vie du commerce (avant, milieu et back office), équilibre des besoins des entreprises, stratégie informatique, sécurité, principes d'intégration et réalité opérationnelle.

• Soyez le partenaire d'architecture pour les projets, les équipes de produits, les fournisseurs et les intégrateurs de systèmes, en établissant des normes claires et des garde-corps pour nos plateformes ETRM, risques, données du marché et règlement.

• Sauvegarder la qualité là où c'est le plus important – examiner l'impact architectural, les risques, les dépendances et la dette de conception technique avant que des changements majeurs ne se produisent, avec un regard aigu sur l'intégrité des données, latence, résilience et auditabilité.

• Aider à orienter la gouvernance de l'architecture, les examens des pouvoirs de conception, la planification de la feuille de route, les priorités du portefeuille et les décisions de faire ou d'acheter pour la division.

Assurez-vous que la réglementation des transactions (REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II) est conçue dès le départ dans le paysage, plutôt que d'être boulonnée plus tard.

• Champion de la normalisation, de la simplification, de la réduction des applications et de la modernisation – toujours peser la valeur commerciale, la sécurité, la durabilité, la qualité et les coûts.

Votre impact

• C'est là que notre valeur, "Créer la valeur, " vient à la vie. Les décisions que vous prenez garantissent que les investissements technologiques de la division Trading produisent des résultats opérationnels réels et durables et soutiennent l'orientation stratégique à long terme d'Alpiq.

Parce que vous définissez le paysage cible avec l'entreprise et nous dirigez vers elle, vous trouvez le juste équilibre entre innovation et risque, ambition et excellence opérationnelle. Vous serez un partenaire fiable pour le commerce, le risque et l'informatique – la personne qui traduit des ambitions audacieuses et des exigences réglementaires en décisions d'architecture et de technologie qui rendent possible la croissance et la transformation futures.

Votre profil

• Nous sommes à la recherche d'un architecte aussi à l'aise avec le trading et le risque qu'avec la technologie. Vous apportez probablement:

• Diplôme en technologie de l'information, en informatique, en génie, en génie financier ou dans un domaine connexe – ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• Une expérience dans l'architecture d'entreprise, de domaine ou de solution, idéalement dans le commerce de l'énergie, les matières premières ou les marchés financiers.

• Une bonne compréhension du cycle de vie du commerce et des systèmes ETRM/CTRM (trading, position and risk management, market data, pricing, settlement and regulatory reporting) et des plateformes telles que Murex, Endur ou Orchestrade.

• Fortes compétences en architecture de solution et d'intégration, ainsi que l'architecture des données et le savoir-faire en matière de sécurité dans des environnements à forte intensité de données en temps réel.

• La capacité de transformer la stratégie commerciale, les besoins commerciaux et la réglementation en un paysage cible TI clair, la conception de solutions et les garde-corps technologiques.

• Expérience de la gouvernance de l'architecture, des examens de conception, du cycle de vie et de la gestion de la dette technique, ainsi que de la prise de décisions technologiques confiantes.

• Expérience avec Enterprise I ntegration P atterns (EIP) , Event Driven Architectures et avec des formes de plate-forme centrées sur les données telles que Foundry ou Databri c ks

• Faciliter la collaboration entre les équipes de prestation internes et les fournisseurs de services externes, les intégrateurs de systèmes et les fournisseurs de plateformes.

Alpiq believes that algorithmic trading and automation will play an increasingly important role in the future of energy trading. While traders remain fully accountable for commercial decisions, risk-taking, and portfolio performance, algorithms are expected to become a core capability supporting execution, optimization, analysis, and decision-making across the trading value chain.

The Head of Algorithmic Trading Governance is responsible for establishing, governing, and scaling Alpiq's algorithmic trading framework across Asset Trading, Merchant Trading, and Structured Energy Management activities.

The role does not manage a proprietary trading book. Instead, it acts as the business owner and governance lead for algorithmic trading initiatives, ensuring consistency, transparency, performance measurement, risk oversight, and adoption across all trading activities.

Initially focused on intraday and day-ahead algorithmic initiatives supporting Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Renewable Energy Sources (RES), the mandate will progressively expand to additional portfolios, including hydro assets and future algorithmic trading applications across Alpiq's European trading activities.

The position sits within the Quantitative Analytics team and operates at the intersection of Trading, IT, Risk Management, Compliance, and Data & Analytics.

Your main accountabilities

1.Algorithmic Trading Governance

• Establish and maintain Alpiq's governance framework for algorithmic trading across all trading value chains.

• Develop standards, controls, validation processes, approval mechanisms, and documentation requirements for algorithm deployment.

• Ensure clear accountability principles whereby traders remain responsible for trading decisions and portfolio outcomes while leveraging algorithmic tools.

• Work closely with Risk and Compliance to develop robust controls around algorithm usage and automated execution activities.

• Define model governance and review processes covering algorithm development, testing, approval, monitoring, modification, and retirement.

2. Portfolio-Wide Algo Coordination & Standardization

• Create a consolidated overview of all existing algorithmic initiatives across Trading.

• Assess and document desk-level developments currently operating within Intraday, Day-Ahead, BESS, RES, and other Gas Merchant trading activities for Long term.

• Identify duplication, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities.

• Drive harmonization of algorithmic approaches across portfolios while preserving local optimization needs.

• Support the extension of successful approaches to additional portfolios, including Hydro and future flexibility assets.

3. Algo Performance Management

• Develop a framework of KPIs and performance metrics for algorithm assessment.

• Monitor algorithm effectiveness under different market environments and liquidity conditions.

• Conduct regular performance reviews and recommend improvements, recalibration, suspension, or retirement of underperforming algorithms.

• Capture and document lessons learned to support future strategy development and knowledge sharing.

• Establish transparency on value creation and operational performance of algorithmic initiatives.

4. Trading Community Enablement

• Lead the adoption of algorithmic trading capabilities across the Trading organization.

• Develop training programs, best practices, user documentation, and onboarding materials.

• Promote a culture where traders understand, monitor, challenge, and effectively utilize algorithmic trading solutions.

• Build an algorithm-enabled trading organization where algorithmic tools become part of every trader’s standard toolkit. The ambition is that within two years, all Alpiq traders are proficient in the use, supervision, and interpretation of algorithmic trading solutions, while retaining full accountability for trading decisions, risk-taking, and portfolio performance.

• Establish a community of practice that fosters knowledge sharing between traders, quants, analysts, developers, Risk, and IT.

• Drive change management and user engagement to accelerate the adoption of automation across Trading's value chains.

5. Strategic Development of Trading Automation

• Define the long-term roadmap for algorithmic trading and automation across Alpiq.

• Evaluate opportunities to expand the use of algorithms beyond execution into analytics, opportunity identification, decision support, forecasting, and idea generation.

• Assess internal versus external development opportunities and support the integration of third-party solutions where appropriate.

• Maintain oversight of external providers and strategic partnerships supporting algorithmic capabilities.

6. Product Ownership and Business Sponsorship

• Act as “Business Sponsor” for strategic algorithmic trading initiatives and transformation projects (4PP).

• Partner closely with Business Technology Transformation and IT including Data teams to ensure developments align and build on Alpiq's broader data transformation roadmap.

• Define business priorities and oversee implementation roadmaps for algorithmic trading platforms and supporting infrastructure.

• Ensure investment decisions and budgets are aligned with business value creation and strategic objectives.

• Support the launch and governance of Alpiq's dedicated algorithmic trading program starting in 2027.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Maintain strong engagement with trading teams in Lausanne and Olten. Algo team shall sit among Traders.

• Work closely with Quantitative Analytics, Risk Management, Compliance, IT, Data Engineering, and Trading leadership.

• Facilitate alignment between business needs, technical capabilities, and governance requirements.

• Promote consistency of algorithmic trading practices across all functions and locations.

Apply now

Experience & Market Knowledge

• Deep understanding of European power markets, including Day-Ahead, Intraday, Balancing, and flexibility markets.

• Strong knowledge of trading processes across physical and financial energy portfolios.

• Experience with algorithmic trading, trading automation, optimization, or quantitative energy trading environments.

• Understanding of flexible asset classes such as batteries, hydro, renewable generation, and flexibility portfolios.

• Proven leadership experience with the ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate innovation into scalable business practices.

• Curious, forward-looking, and technology-oriented mindset, with a genuine interest in the future evolution of energy trading and automation.

• Ability to operate effectively in a rapidly evolving environment, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic execution as markets, technologies, and organizational priorities evolve.

• Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate across Trading, Quantitative Analytics, IT, Risk, Compliance, and senior management.

• Strong change management capabilities, with experience driving adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working across an organization.

Quantitative & Technical Expertise

• Strong understanding of algorithm design, quantitative modeling, machine learning applications, and automated execution frameworks.

• Familiarity with Python and modern data analytics environments.

• Ability to challenge and oversee technical developments without necessarily performing day-to-day coding activities.

• Understanding of data architecture, trading systems, and algorithm performance measurement frameworks.

Governance, Risk & Leadership

• Experience establishing governance frameworks, controls, and operational processes.

• Strong understanding of risk management principles and regulatory requirements relevant to automated trading.

• Ability to operate across multiple departments and influence stakeholders without direct hierarchical authority.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Structured and strategic thinker capable of translating innovation into scalable business practices.

Success Measures

The successful candidate will:

• Establish a robust algorithmic trading governance framework across Alpiq.

• Create full visibility and oversight of all algorithmic trading initiatives.

• Increase algorithm adoption across trading teams.

• Drive standardization and consistency across portfolios and value chains.

• Improve transparency on algorithm performance and value creation.

• Ensure algorithms are deployed safely, efficiently, and in line with risk and compliance standards.

• Position Alpiq to scale algorithmic trading capabilities as a strategic competitive advantage while maintaining clear human accountability for trading decisions.

jobs.description:
Mission

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing trading strategies across European short-term power markets, with a particular focus on the UK market. While acting as a specialist for Great Britain (GB) power trading, you will actively participate in the trading and optimization of Alpiq's wider European portfolio covering Germany, France, Austria, Belgium, the Netherlands and the Nordic power markets. The role combines UK market specialization with broader participation in Alpiq's CWE and Nordic trading activities.

You will be joining a team of experienced traders and algo traders operating across Europe on a 7/7-day shift basis during extended working hours. The team is responsible for proprietary trading activities as well as the optimization of renewable assets and batteries from DA down to balancing markets. Working closely with analysts, quantitative researchers, meteorologists, IT developers and our 24/7 intraday desk, you will contribute to maximizing value creation in increasingly automated and data-driven power markets.

Your main responsibilities

• Trade a virtual power plant portfolio of wind/solar in DE, FR, FI, SE on a 7/7-day shift basis in Intraday and Day Ahead market

• Act as the in-house expert for UK short-term power markets, bringing deep knowledge of Day-Ahead, Intraday, balancing and flexibility market dynamics.

• Develop and execute proprietary trading strategies across UK, CWE and Nordic power markets, with a particular focus on UK market opportunities arising from renewable penetration, system imbalances, storage assets and transmission constraints.

• Contribute to the commercial development and optimization of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) in the UK market by identifying monetization opportunities, trading strategies and route-to-market solutions across wholesale, balancing and ancillary service markets.

• Provide market expertise on battery economics, congestion management opportunities, revenue stacking and short-term optimization strategies.

• Manage the risk exposure of proprietary trading positions in accordance with internal mandates, risk policies and trading limits.

• Monitor and analyse market fundamentals including weather developments, generation forecasts, renewable production, demand forecasts, fuel prices, interconnector flows and balancing market signals.

• Contribute to the development, testing and implementation of algorithmic trading strategies together with Alpiq's algo trading and quantitative teams.

• Participate in the conceptualization and continuous improvement of automated trading services, forecasting models, workflow automation and analytical tools.

• Perform daily assessment of trading performance through P&L analysis, strategy reviews and back-testing of trading decisions.

• Prepare regular trading performance reports and communicate market developments, opportunities and strategic recommendations to stakeholders.

• Share market knowledge, best practices and trading insights with colleagues across the trading organization and support onboarding of new team members.

• Collaborate closely with originators, pricing and quantitative analysts, developers, risk managers, operations and middle-office teams to improve overall trading performance.

• Help further develop Alpiq's position as a leading player in short-term power trading across the UK, Central Western Europe and Nordic power markets.
Your impact

While serving as the UK's market expert within the desk, you will contribute to the overall performance of the CWE & Nordics short-term trading team. Your ability to connect developments in the UK market with dynamics across Continental Europe and the Nordics will help capture cross-market opportunities and strengthen Alpiq's pan-European trading capabilities.

Your profile

• Bachelor or Master’s degree in engineering, Economics, IT or similar

• Minimum 2 years of experience in power trading with proven expertise in UK Day-Ahead and Intraday power markets.

• Demonstrated experience in Renewables trading and in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), flexibility markets or battery optimization strategies within the UK market.

• Understanding of European Short Term Power markets.

• Knowledge of French, Belgian and Dutch power markets is a strong advantage, given their close interaction with UK interconnector flows.

• Strong analytical skills with a strategic mindset

• Open-minded, multi-tasking and used to working in a fast paced, high-pressure environment

• Strong Team-player and problem-solver

• Excellent commercial mind-set and very good communicator

• Good programming and IT skills (ideally Python).

• Experience with algorithmic and systematic trading using automated trading environments is considered a strong advantage.

• Strong interest in leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics to enhance trading performance.

• Proficient level of English.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Missione

In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili per lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di strategie di trading su mercati europei a breve termine, con una particolare attenzione sul mercato britannico. Mentre fai da specialista per il trading di potenza in Gran Bretagna (GB), parteciperai attivamente al trading e all'ottimizzazione del portafoglio europeo di Alpiq che copre Germania, Francia, Austria, Belgio, Paesi Bassi e i mercati del potere nordico. Il ruolo combina la specializzazione del mercato del Regno Unito con una partecipazione più ampia alle attività di commercio nordico e CWE di Alpiq.

Ti unirai a un team di commercianti esperti e commercianti di algo che operano in tutta Europa su una base di turni di 7/7 giorni durante le ore di lavoro prolungate. Le tue principali responsabilità

• Agire come esperto interno per i mercati di potenza a breve termine del Regno Unito, portando profonda conoscenza di Day-Ahead, Intraday, bilanciamento e flessibilità dinamica del mercato.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di trading proprietarie nei mercati UK, CWE e Nordic Power, con una particolare attenzione alle opportunità di mercato del Regno Unito derivanti da penetrazione rinnovabile, squilibri di sistema, risorse di storage e vincoli di trasmissione.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo commerciale e all'ottimizzazione dei sistemi di stoccaggio dell'energia della batteria (BESS) nel mercato del Regno Unito identificando opportunità di monetizzazione, strategie di trading e soluzioni di route-to-market nei mercati dei servizi all'ingrosso, bilanciamento e accessori.

• Fornire competenze di mercato su economia della batteria, opportunità di gestione della congestione, strategie di stacking dei ricavi e di ottimizzazione a breve termine.

• Gestire l'esposizione al rischio di posizioni di trading proprietarie in conformità con mandati interni, politiche di rischio e limiti di trading.

• Monitorare e analizzare i fondamenti del mercato, compresi gli sviluppi meteorologici, le previsioni di generazione, la produzione rinnovabile, le previsioni della domanda, i prezzi del carburante, i flussi di interconnessione e il bilanciamento dei segnali di mercato.

• Contribuisci allo sviluppo, alla sperimentazione e all'implementazione di strategie di trading algoritmico insieme ai team di algo trading di Alpiq.

• Partecipare alla concettualizzazione e al miglioramento continuo dei servizi di trading automatizzati, modelli di previsione, automazione del flusso di lavoro e strumenti analitici.

• Eseguire la valutazione quotidiana delle prestazioni di trading attraverso l'analisi P&L, le recensioni di strategia e il back-test delle decisioni di trading.

• Preparare rapporti regolari sulle prestazioni di trading e comunicare sviluppi di mercato, opportunità e raccomandazioni strategiche per gli stakeholder.

• Condividere le conoscenze di mercato, le migliori pratiche e le intuizioni di trading con i colleghi di tutta l'organizzazione di trading e il supporto a bordo di nuovi membri del team.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i creatori, i prezzi e gli analisti quantitativi, gli sviluppatori, i responsabili dei rischi, le operazioni e i team di middle office per migliorare le prestazioni di trading globali.

• Aiuta a sviluppare ulteriormente la posizione di Alpiq come protagonista nel trading di energia a breve termine in tutto il Regno Unito, nell'Europa centrale occidentale e nei mercati nordici.
Il tuo impatto

Mentre serve come esperto di mercato del Regno Unito all'interno della scrivania, contribuirai alle prestazioni generali del team di trading a breve termine CWE & Nordics. La vostra capacità di collegare gli sviluppi nel mercato del Regno Unito con le dinamiche in tutta l'Europa continentale e i nordici contribuirà a catturare le opportunità di mercato cross-market e rafforzare le capacità di trading paneuropee di Alpiq.

Il tuo profilo

• Laurea o Master in ingegneria, economia, IT o simili

• Minimo 2 anni di esperienza nel trading di potenza con comprovata esperienza nei mercati di potenza di UK Day-Ahead e Intraday.

• Esperienza dimostrata nel Renewables trading e nei Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), nei mercati di flessibilità o nelle strategie di ottimizzazione delle batterie nel mercato britannico.

• Comprensione dei mercati europei di energia a breve termine.

• La conoscenza dei mercati del potere francese, belga e olandese è un forte vantaggio, data la loro stretta interazione con i flussi di interconnessione del Regno Unito.

• Forte capacità analitiche con una mentalità strategica

• A mente aperta, multi-tasking e utilizzato per lavorare in un ambiente veloce e ad alta pressione

• Forte Team-player e problem-solver

• Eccellente mentalità commerciale e ottimo comunicatore

• Buone competenze di programmazione e IT (idealmente Python).

• L'esperienza con il trading algoritmico e sistematico utilizzando ambienti di trading automatizzati è considerata un forte vantaggio.

• Forte interesse a sfruttare Artificial Intelligence (AI) e analisi avanzate per migliorare le prestazioni di trading.

• Livello competente di inglese.

Join an international team dedicated to the development and delivery of hydroelectric projects in Europe. As a Project Manager, you will contribute your technical, environmental and regulatory expertise during the project development phases and take responsibility for their delivery following the final investment decision (FID).

Your main responsibilities

• Provide technical support to development teams in the evaluation of hydropower projects across Europe.

• Define, manage and challenge engineering, geological, environmental and permitting studies carried out by external consultants.
